summary: Tested Family (Keluarga) tab on Student Profile end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_family_profile.py with 11 pytest cases exercising PUT /api/profile family validation (missing family, empty object, invalid NIK length, invalid parent status, count mismatch with members array, count>15, empty electricityPower, deceased parent still requiring all detail fields) and acceptance (valid family with otherMemberCount='0' string normalized to int 0, GET returns normalized family after save, two-member payload persists and re-GET returns identical structure). Result: 11/11 PASSED. Frontend: Playwright against public preview URL — logged in as demo Mahasiswa, verified all 15 family testids (family-profile-section, family-father-*, family-mother-*, family-other-member-count, family-electricity-power) exist. Rupiah input: typing 1000000 renders as '1.000.000'. Dynamic count: 2->2 cards, 1->1 card, 0->0 cards. Meninggal status keeps phone/income/job inputs editable and marked required. Save button clicked with incomplete family shows sonner toast 'Lengkapi Data Keluarga: Nama Lengkap Ayah.' Profile-completion summary on Ringkasan and on Profil Saya (14% chip list) shows 'Data Keluarga' as ONE item — no exploded family field labels found. Mobile 390px viewport: horizontal overflow delta = 0 (scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390).
action_items: Documentation nit: review request lists Test ID `save-profile-button`, but actual button uses data-testid=`save-profile-btn` (in /app/frontend/src/pages/student/StudentDashboard.jsx line ~314). Either update review docs or rename the testid for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: normalize_family_profile is strict and correctly rejects each invalid case (verified). Consider centralizing the max-length constants (160/40) alongside the frontend limits so both sides evolve together.

getMissingProfileFields (StudentProfile.jsx line 68) collapses ALL missing family fields into one summary chip {k:'family', l:'Data Keluarga'}, satisfying spec point 9; profileProgress still counts every individual family field for the percentage. Behaviour matches requirement.
FamilyProfileSection.parseFamilyCount clamps to 0..15 in the UI; server also enforces max 15. Consistent.
seed_data_creation: Demo mahasiswa profile was mutated during backend tests. Restored via direct MongoDB access: db.users.update_one set name back to 'Mahasiswa Demo MDJ' and db.profiles.delete_one({user_id}) so GET /api/profile returns the fresh default (matches original state pre-testing — no family, minimal data). Verified restoration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Family testids follow pattern family-father-{name|nik|status|phone|job|income}, family-mother-*, family-member-{index}-{name|nik|relationship|education|job|income}, plus family-other-member-count, family-electricity-power, family-profile-section, family-other-members-list, family-father-card, family-mother-card, family-member-{i}-card. Save button testid is `save-profile-btn` (NOT `save-profile-button`). PUT /api/profile requires body {"data": {...profile_fields..., "family": {...}}}; if role=student, family is validated by normalize_family_profile which raises 400 with Indonesian messages for each failure. Rupiah rendering: input stores digits-only, displays with '.' thousand separators via formatRupiah(). Demo mahasiswa cookie-based session persists across tests; if UI test fails to click 'Masuk', re-run — probably already logged in; safer path is to explicitly log in from /login using Mahasiswa demo pill.
